scope: Exact finite synthetic decision problem only. The state prior and observation outcomes are fully enumerated; this is an oracle control, not a physical EGB model or a learned policy result.

actions.description: Reveal the within-class subtype bit, which is independent of the decision class.
Reveal the decision class, which directly changes the optimal decision.

expected.selection_rule: maximize expected reduction in Bayes decision risk minus action cost; information gain is reported separately and is not the objective

assertions: Both actions have exactly one bit of Shannon information gain under the enumerated uniform prior.
The entropy-only action leaves the posterior decision risk unchanged and has negative net value after cost.
The decision-relevant action reduces Bayes risk from 1/2 to 0 and has positive net value after the same cost.
The selected action must be B_decision_relevant even though both actions have equal information gain and equal cost.
Changing the frozen prior, decision classes, outcomes or costs without changing expected values must fail closed.
claim_ceiling: This exact finite oracle control demonstrates the difference between information gain and decision value. It does not validate a real-world utility model, EGB computation, prospective Symthaea VoC, or policy performance.
